description:
We need an experienced SAP HANA Developer that can perform HANA modeling and development.
 

 - Strong knowledge of HANA View Modeling e.g. Analytical View, Attribute View and different Calculation Views
 

 - Minimum of 2 years of HANA modeling experience
 

 - Good understand of different joins and unions used in the HANA modeling e.g. Inner join, Outer joins, Referential joins etc.
 

 - Ability to write SQL Scripts, stored procedures and integrate them in the views
 

 - Understanding of different perspective in HANA Developer Studio
 

 - Ability to run plan viz to analyze performance bottlenecks in the HANA views
 

 - Understanding of different techniques to optimize performance of HANA views
 

 - Ability to translate functional requirements into technical spec document
 

 - Good understanding of filters and parameters used of HANA views and usage of them
 

 - Understanding of different data provisioning mechanism
 

 - Knowledge of BO or Tableau reporting tools is an advantage
 

 - Knowledge of BW on HANA modeling is a plus


 GOOD COMMUNICATION SKILLS 
 
 DURATION: 6+ Months Contract   
 
 INTERVIEW: PHONE & SKYPE
years_evidence: - Minimum of 2 years of HANA modeling experience
